name: lu-corporate-tax
description: Use this skill for Luxembourg corporate income tax on resident companies (SA, SARL, SARL-S, SAS, SCA, SE, cooperatives) and on Luxembourg permanent establishments of foreign companies, for tax year 2026. Covers impôt sur le revenu des collectivités (IRC) at 14% / 16% with the EUR 175,000 to 200,000 band, the 7% contribution au fonds pour l'emploi, municipal business tax (impôt commercial communal, ICC) with the EUR 17,500 allowance and the Luxembourg City 225% multiplier, the combined 23.87% rate, net wealth tax and minimum net wealth tax, participation exemption (art. 166 LIR), 17-year loss carry-forward, fiscal unity (art. 164bis), interest limitation (art. 168bis), CFC rules, filing and quarterly advances, penalties, and dividend withholding tax. Trigger on: 'Luxembourg corporate tax', 'IRC Luxembourg', 'SARL tax', 'Soparfi', 'intégration fiscale'.
